comparators_or_controls: Previous ungrouped 16-bin learner under both laws on same 64 images and budget, fair 50% expectation, integer twin, two-way opposite convention memory swap, clear/sham/restore, membership-only erasure, all equally sized groups, and fixed +17 cyclic reassignment of balanced teaching bits.
decision_rule: Pass separately under parity and not-all-equal only if every true L/T, held turn 180/270, both seen/new position and each globally blind E/F style cell has strictly above half correct (16 cells of 8 per law). Report balanced neutral/chance and old method separately.
first_executable_signal: Previous study motivates this one-shot prospective test. Synthetic class separations/ties, new-array K1-K3 checks, nearest-mean predicate and anonymous re-encoding checks precede release.
forbidden_inputs: Class names, pixel pose metadata, rotation rules, per-category population count, transformed templates, manually tied categories, augmented training images, row IDs, answer keys and test labels.
inputs: 64 row-major binary pixels per presentation; the reader issues one bit, followed by only correct/incorrect in training.
mapping: Acquire 64 histograms and inferred actions in ternary holdings. At finalize search every unordered categorical bipartition. Maximize squared class-mean separation over summed population variances, infinite for a nonzero difference at zero spread. Minimize smaller-side size at equal rank and retain all ties. Mark winners and class marginals in physical holds, erase receipts and vote by nearest scalar class means with midpoint abstention and action zero on ties.
nonclaims: Class-conditional transfer measured on two reserved stroke designs; no claim of arbitrary font recognition, discovered geometry, learned sensor or advantage of knot storage over the same ordinary learner.
outputs: One bit per bitmap interpreted in the fixed recipient convention. Diagnostic votes/marks saved independently.
primary_observable: Correct/total per class, turn, position regime and reserved shape; causal change on identical inputs.
question: Does binary correctness teach which anonymous raw-pixel pattern counts can be combined to recognize both letters at untrained quarter turns on new glyph designs?
resource_budget: 64 training images per arm, 11 physical and integer fits, 704 held-out decisions per issued arm. Exact search of 32767 unordered partitions. No fitting or tuning on the excluded angles or blind styles.
reviews: Pre-freeze Astra Max R0 on this file, final detached freeze binds it and R0. R1 authorizes that exact freeze, R2 independently replays the acquired states and scores. External scientific referee receives a handoff.
stop_rule: Run both laws to the locked test once. Stop after comparison and causal checks, including failure.
